entries.value_or_rule: Documented hard declines and missing method, India-issued card or disconnected Connect account prevent automatic retry.
entries.limitation: Not all network advice or regulatory rules modeled; no live execution authority.

entries.value_or_rule: Network advice/decline code interpretation depends on the network; advice may be absent.
entries.limitation: Simulator blocks automated retry for any supplied advice it cannot interpret.

entries.value_or_rule: Consumers must handle duplicate events and delivery order not matching creation order.
entries.limitation: Delay/duplicate rates are invented. Internal sim.* events are NOT version-pinned Stripe payloads.
All probabilities, effect sizes, monetary costs, country weights and behavioral distributions are hypothetical.

entries.value_or_rule: Conditional window probability 1-(1-q)^(days/30), bounded steps/retries and one episode reward.
entries.limitation: Uncalibrated local transition model; next-window oracle is not full-policy counterfactual value.

entries.population: sequential policy evaluation mathematical framework, not merchant measurements
entries.value_or_rule: Trajectory importance ratios multiply conditional target/behavior action probabilities. Unbiasedness depends on support and the data-generating assumptions; variance can be large.
entries.limitation: This release implements unclipped trajectory IS, not the paper's doubly robust estimator. Customer-level histories and fixed enrollment are simulator-specific assumptions.

entries.population: fixed synthetic worlds and initial-failure cohorts
entries.value_or_rule: Complete policy reruns share seeded world state and semantic event/window noise. Financial reward uses30 days from initial failure, including decisionless natural recovery.
entries.limitation: Merchant bootstrap intervals are conditional on the chosen worlds. No real bank/customer causal effect is inferred.
Scenario names do not establish real-world population fidelity.

benchmark_decision: No numeric market benchmark adopted: population, denominator and transferability have not been independently established. No blended recovery rate.
